# computesphere_services (Data Source)

Provides a list of services.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    computesphere = {
      source = "computesphere.com/computesphere/computesphere"
    }
  }
}

variable "api_token" {
  description = "API token for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "account_id" {
  description = "Account ID for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
}

variable "api_url" {
  description = "API URL for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
  default     = "api.computesphere.com"
}

provider "computesphere" {
  api_token  = var.api_token  # or set COMPUTESPHERE_API_TOKEN env variable
  account_id = var.account_id # or set COMPUTESPHERE_ACCOUNT_ID env variable
  api_url    = var.api_url    # or set COMPUTESPHERE_API_URL env variable
}

data "computesphere_services" "example" {
  project_id = "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890ab"
}

output "services" {
  value = data.computesphere_services.example
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Project to list services for.

### Read-Only

- `services` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))

<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Required:

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the service.

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the service is active.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp of the service.
- `last_opened_at` (String) Last opened timestamp of the service.
- `name` (String) Name of the service.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID associated with the service.
- `type` (String) Type of the service.
